name: cc-payroll
description: AI-powered payroll operations companion for SAP Payroll Control Center. Analyze period-over-period variances, generate stakeholder reports, reconcile payroll to GL, triage alerts, validate compliance, and analyze retroactive adjustments. Includes 7 core skills: Variance Analyzer, Payroll Reporting, Payroll Knowledge Base, GL Reconciliation, Alert Triage, Compliance Audit, and Retro Processing. Works with your existing XLSX exports — no SAP integration required.
